entries.title: Special Teahouse Activity
entries.text: Please join us today, Thu 11/19 in the Teahouse for a special activity from 10:15am-1:00pm. We look forward to being present, creating and connecting with you.

entries.title: Holy Eucharist Service
entries.text: All are welcome to our Holy Eucharist service tomorrow, Friday, November 20, at 3:15 p.m. in St. Alban’s Chapel. Join us to pause, pray, and share in the Holy Sacrament of bread and wine; grape juice is available for those under 21. Please come as you can to begin the weekend.

MUSICAL THEATRE CLASSES IN CONCERT at Mamiya Theatre this weekend! Join us on Friday and/or Saturday night at 7pm at Mamiya Theatre on the St. Louis Campus for an evening of Musical Theatre! Musical Theatre 3, our top level class takes the stage on Friday, and on Saturday at 7pm Musical Theatre levels 1 and 2 will share a different program! NO TICKETS needed! This event is free and open to the public. Doors open for seating at 6:30pm both days. Come enjoy songs from Beauty and the Beast, A Chorus Line, Wicked, Rent, and more!

VIRTUAL POP-UP! Get your Young Entrepreneurs Club Virtual Pop-up pre-orders in before it's too late! Pickup will be Monday, November 30. GRS 11-12 CHAPEL: LETTER-WRITING PROJECT FOR FOODBANK: Rally your friends, teams, and clubs for our project for the Hawaiʻi Foodbank! Students, stop by the tables right here, in the back of the chapel to pick up templates for your group, or just sit and write a quick, happy note yourself. These will be included with the food that keiki take home from school, to their families in need. SRS: Show your appreciation. Grab thank you cards from CCO or SAO office. Please write and hand-deliver a personal note to your teachers writing your recommendation letters, to thank them for their time and support.

entries.title: Pizza & Pasta Food Drive Challenge
entries.text: Time to get FoodDriveMaxxing and win your homeroom a homecooked breakfast! Check your homeroom's assigned ingredient for our Pizza & Pasta Food Drive Challenge and donate generously to support our community. Collection boxes will be in homerooms. GRS 7-10: FOOD4THOUGHT: A NEW OPPORTUNITY FOR RESCUE: Honolulu’s G.R.O.W. program lets households put food scraps into their green bins, turning leftovers and peels into compost. Help your family participate correctly: keep edible food for eating first, then put accepted scraps in, loose, without any packaging or bags. Watch the 1:23 HNN news story HERE

entries.title: Lā Kūʻokoʻa (HAWIIAN INDEPENDENCE DAY)
entries.text: All 8th graders have a mandatory event to celebrate Lā Kūʻokoʻa (Hawaiian Independence Day) on Tue. Nov 24 in Seto during the meeting period, beginning at 10:45 am and ending at 11:40 am.

entries.title: Gender-sexuality Alliance
entries.text: Join us tomorrow, Fri, 11/20, lunch, W-311. We will gather in honor of Transgender Day of Remembrance. Bring your lunch & a friend. Everyone welcome!

entries.title: Okinawan Club
entries.text: Hai Sai - Hai Tai! Please join us today, Thurs, 11/19, lunch, W215 for our second official Okinawan Club Meeting of this school year. Bring $10 dues and join us for andagi, snacks, Okinawan culture and fun! Dues need to be paid for our yummy club lunches and to be on the OFFICIAL ROSTER.
